claims.claim: OCBC's ATM, Internet and mobile banking services were disrupted on 23 September
claims.reason: S1 is dated Wednesday 23 Sep 2026. It refers to 'today's disruption of automated-teller machine, Internet and mobile-phone banking services' at OCBC.

claims.claim: CEO David Conner said all customer data remained protected
claims.reason: S1 says David Conner, OCBC's chief executive officer, stated in an e-mailed statement that all customer data was protected with 'appropriate security measures'.
